notes.title: Nomori Development Update News
notes.content: [p]Hello friends of Nomori, It’s been a while! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support while we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes. Our puzzle adventure game Nomori is slowly becoming a reality, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon. [/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to Wishlist Nomori's main steampage: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2932680/Nomori/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The world of Nomori is coming to life in exciting ways, new places to explore and more characters to meet. We hope you’ll feel a connection with them as you journey together through this enchanted world. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42750289/4bd3abcd6432a34afb39ee81c05f69c4b51c8ecd.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re also hard at work designing new levels that are both challenging and fun! We invite you to join our community discord if you are interested in helping us with playtesting and make Nomori a reality! [/p][p][/p][p]We have more updates to share, and content to show as we work towards our release date. Thank you so much for walking this path with us and please stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Pre-Alpha update is out now!
notes.content:
Last week we unveiled the official Steam page for Nomori. Right now, you can play the updated Pre-Alpha of Nomori, available on the Prologue page!

Even though the game is still under development, we want to share the work we put in the game for the last year and a half since releasing the tech-demo. We think the game is now at a state where it’s fun to play. We would love to see as many people play it as possible, so we can make the game even better!

The new version, Pre-Alpha 0.9, includes 18 new levels that teach Nomori’s mechanics and challenge your understanding of Nomori’s reality. Furthermore, there are a bunch of new features, like time paths that move through portals, Kodama rescuing, checkpoints and a little taste of the game’s narrative via character conversations! Unfortunately, the update breaks the localization that was included in the previous version. In the coming period, we will work to re-add languages to the game and patch any major issues that come to light.

Keep in mind that your experience of the Pre-Alpha may not be perfectly smooth. Pre-Alpha means that the game is not even feature-complete yet, and even now we’re developing systems and features for the final game. Still, we hope that you enjoy what Nomori has to offer so far!

notes.title: April 2024 Nomori Update
notes.content:
Hello there! I hope you are doing well. I hate to break it to you, but it’s already April.

The team at Enchanted Works has been working on Nomori at a slow but steady pace for the last months. We’re not developing full-time yet, but a lot has happened since the last update and I’d love to fill you in!

[h2]Nomori was at GDC![/h2]

The Game Developers Conference is probably the most prestigious and most expensive event in the game development industry. We did not expect to attend before Nomori would be very close to release. However, we were invited to showcase a new demo of the game at the Made With Unity booth and did not reject the offer! 

It was a great experience for two reasons. First and foremost, we’re still looking for funding. Talking to dozens and dozens of people in person at GDC is great networking. Even when some people couldn’t offer meaningful help, they would come back to the booth later bringing a person with them they thought should see the game. Secondly, hearing people react to our game in person is really fulfilling! Nice comments, feedback, curious questions and compliments confirm that our hard work is starting to pay off and that we have a chance at finding a publishing deal for Nomori. It motivates us to continue working, even in the current state of the industry.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42750289/ebef59663f1bd7e2d9b0bd7016eb663e0fb5df97.jpg[/img]

[h2]Nomori’s new features[/h2]

So what’s this new demo you say? It’s a new version that smoothes out a lot of things from the alpha that is on Steam. We’ve been posting sneak-peaks already in our [url=https://discord.gg/mAKStQrY52]Discord[/url], and I’ll share with you the biggest changes here:
[list]
[*]Nomori’s art direction has basically been rebuilt from the ground up, after exploring styles in the alpha version. We’ve now defined the look and feel for Nomori! In the new version, we are showing the first of four environments the game will take place in, the Autumn Domain. I’ll let you guess what the other three will be. We also introduce the first NPC characters!
[*]Part of solidifying the artstyle is working out the world of Nomori. Who lives there? What’s their story? In this process we’ve changed a few characters. For example, the bunny spirit that will accompany Kiko during her journey has a name now: Yuki! And the big stone block you can perform telekinesis on is now alive as a Slimebun! Trademark pending.
[*]We added onto the main gameplay. On your journey through Nomori’s twisted levels, you will be on the lookout for stranded spirits to take with you in your backpack. Prepare for spirits to be out of bounds. We know you will look.
[*]New gameplay mechanics have been added. Now time-reversal is operational through portals, which increases puzzle potential by approximately 500%! Slimebuns of various sizes affect each other physically in a meaningful way, and checkpoints let you solve levels faster by failing faster.
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42750289/d13ebb3a2f2e6a22ff36421d4b19afc6a2f1e22a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Cool, when can I play?[/h2]

We’re preparing this new version to replace the alpha version that’s on Steam right now. It will be more reflective of the finished game, but not resemble it by a long shot. Our main goal still is to get user feedback and improve the experience of the game. That’s why it will still be free to play! I cannot say exactly when the update will drop. Be sure to follow us, for example through our [url=https://discord.gg/mAKStQrY52]Discord [/url]or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/enchantedworks]Steam [/url]to stay notified!

That’s all for now. Until next time!

- Joeri

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase and development update!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are delighted to tell that you that Nomori Prologue is part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase and also that it's happening right now! Until the 7th of august you can browse dozens of brilliant and cool and often discounted puzzle games. We can't recommend it enough!

You may have noticed our fancy new key art in the promotion for the event. Let me give you an update on what we're working on at the moment. We've been hard at work developing and solidifying Nomori's art style. The early access version of Nomori Prologue features placeholder assets for most of the game. We're not only replacing those with our own trees, bushes, rocks and other props, but also making characters, vfx, and UI.

It's all work we're doing on our way to a vertical slice of the game: an early piece of Nomori that will look and play just like the final game. The vertical slice is a couple of months away. We're still developing Nomori largely unpaid. However, Enchanted Works recently acquired a grant from the Dutch government to work on the vertical slice. It's really helpful since it will let us worry less about rent, and spend more time on Nomori.

To finish it up, I'd like to share some insider information with you: we have successfully overcome a major technical challenge within one of our planned game mechanics, and the implications for Nomori's puzzles are huge. It has to do with portals and time travel, but I'd need a Ted Talk to properly explain it. I hope you'll learn about it yourself when you play the next version of the Prologue.

So long,
Joeri

notes.title: Update 0.6.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
The new update is a quality-of-live update that adds controller support, full input rebinding and extra control settings to the game in a fresh menu. It took us longer than expected, but we really wanted to get it right. Accessibility means a lot to us! We think that the features we added are a good starting point and we’re eagerly awaiting feedback. The game is now localized to new languages, including Chinese, German, French and Russian. We also massively improved performance by optimizing portal rendering even further. If you’re curious, go play now!

We have also opened a discord for Nomori! You can [url=https://discord.gg/mAKStQrY52]join here[/url] to get more direct contact with us.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Massive performance increases (Portals finally received much needed optimization)
[*] Particle system optimization
[*] Smoothed out the time reversal
[*] Portal Rotation improvements
[*] Lots of visual glitch fixes
[*] Better checkpoints
[*] Added German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French and Russian localization
[*] Added support for Xbox and Playstation controller input
[*] Added audio volume option
[*] Added full input rebinding
[*] Added control settings
[*] Added credits
[*] Brand new menu UI
[*] New music by Vijay!
[/list]

notes.title: Little news update!
notes.content:
Hello! I want to give you a little update and share what we're currently working on. Now that Nomori is public, we enjoy reading your reviews, kind words and feedback. It may seem like a mad decision to release a Pre-Alpha version of a game publicly. A version that does not have a final artstyle, complete gameplay loop, or optimized code! But we think it was the best thing to do, to see how people react to Nomori's weird mechanics and crazy levels. We're observing, and learning. And in the meantime, working on baseline features that any released game should have.

[b]Controller support & Rebinding[/b]

We're working hard to implement controller support and rebinding to Nomori. Unity makes this very doable with their new input system, but their documentation on it is very difficult to work with. We expect to release an update in the next few weeks, so stay tuned!

[b]Around the game[/b]

Releasing the Pre-Alpha also opened many of doors for us. We're still actively looking for publishing and investment opportunitie, and that takes up a lot of time from our team. It is essential work though, because we need funds to sustain ourselves if we want to develop Nomori fulltime. We're enthusiastic to keep working!

That's all for now,

[i]Joeri[/i]
